title: ApplianceDB: Appliance Error Codes & Repairs
subtitle: Appliance fault codes mapped to ranked repairs, OEM parts, and provenance
description:
# ApplianceDB: Home Appliance Error Codes & Ranked Repairs

Relational database mapping 438 home-appliance error codes across 13 brands and 26 (brand, appliance-type) pairs to 288 ranked repair procedures with DIY difficulty tiers. Every code is identified by its composite (brand, appliance_type, code) key — Samsung washer 5C is a distinct record from Samsung dishwasher 5C.

## Provenance & Methodology

Every code fact is re-derived from an official manufacturer support listing (LG, Samsung, GE) with the exact source URL recorded per row; all meanings and repair steps are paraphrased into original wording (no verbatim manufacturer prose). Repair ranks carry an explicit basis (manufacturer_first). Costs are left NULL where no verified price observation exists — never guessed. Each release is built by a deterministic, test-gated pipeline (composite-uniqueness, controlled-vocabulary, rank-contiguity, and >=10-codes-per-pair coverage gates).

Full documentation and data dictionary: https://github.com/ApplianceDB/ApplianceDB-public

resources.description: Master registry of appliance error codes keyed by (brand, appliance_type, code) with manufacturer provenance.

fields.name: code_id
fields.description: Primary key identifier for the error-code record.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Appliance manufacturer (e.g., LG, Samsung, GE).

fields.name: market
fields.description: Sales market the code listing applies to (US, UK, EU, CA, AU) — the same brand ships different code sets per region, so market is part of the code identity.

fields.name: appliance_type
fields.description: Appliance category: washer, dryer, dishwasher, refrigerator, oven_range, microwave, hvac, water_heater.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Normalized error/fault code as shown on the appliance display (uppercase, separators stripped).

fields.name: meaning
fields.description: Original-wording explanation of what the code indicates (paraphrased from the source listing, never verbatim).

fields.name: component
fields.description: Primary component or subsystem implicated by the code.

fields.name: cause_category
fields.description: Fault category (drainage, water_supply, sensor, motor, heating, door_lock, compressor, defrost, fan, communication, power, ventilation, leak, refrigerant, ice_maker, suds, unbalanced, dispenser, temperature, filter, control_board, informational).

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Operational impact: informational, degraded, or stop_failure.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Provenance tier: 'manufacturer_listing' (official brand support page) or 'aggregator_listing' (reputable secondary repair reference).

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the listing the facts were derived from.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Exact source URL used as the provenance for this code.

resources.description: Probability-ranked repair procedures per error code with DIY difficulty tiers.

fields.name: procedure_id
fields.description: Primary key identifier for the repair procedure.

fields.name: code_id
fields.description: Foreign key referencing error_codes.code_id.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Appliance manufacturer.

fields.name: market
fields.description: Sales market of the parent code.

fields.name: appliance_type
fields.description: Appliance category.

fields.name: code
fields.description: The error code this procedure resolves.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Order to attempt this fix (1 = try first); contiguous 1..N per code.

fields.name: rank_basis
fields.description: Why this rank was assigned: manufacturer_first, frequency_reported, or cost_ascending.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short actionable title of the repair step.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Original-wording step-by-step remedy paraphrased from the manufacturer's guidance.

fields.name: diy_difficulty
fields.description: Skill required: easy, moderate, advanced, or professional_only.

fields.name: est_labor_minutes
fields.description: Estimated labor time in minutes (NULL where not observed).

fields.name: parts_cost_min
fields.description: Minimum parts cost in cost_currency units (NULL where no verified price observation).

fields.name: parts_cost_max
fields.description: Maximum parts cost in cost_currency units (NULL where no verified price observation).

fields.name: cost_currency
fields.description: ISO currency of the cost range (USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD) — costs are observed in the market's own currency, never converted.

fields.name: cost_year
fields.description: Year the cost range was observed (costs decay; always dated).

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Provenance tier of the parent code's listing (manufacturer_listing or aggregator_listing) — the remedy is paraphrased from the same listing.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source URL of the parent code's listing, the provenance for this remedy.

resources.description: OEM replacement parts with observed street-price ranges (populated as price observations are recorded).

fields.name: part_id
fields.description: Primary key identifier for the replacement part.

fields.name: procedure_id
fields.description: Repair procedure this part is mapped to (FK to repair_procedures).

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Manufacturer of the part; empty for universal/aftermarket parts.

fields.name: appliance_type
fields.description: Appliance category of the linked error code.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Error code whose repair procedure uses this part.

fields.name: oem_part_number
fields.description: Exact OEM part number (character-for-character from the source).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name/description of the replacement part.

fields.name: street_price_min
fields.description: Minimum observed street price in price_currency units.

fields.name: street_price_max
fields.description: Maximum observed street price in price_currency units.

fields.name: price_currency
fields.description: ISO currency of the observed price range (USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD).

fields.name: cost_year
fields.description: Year the price range was observed.

fields.name: price_source_url
fields.description: Primary retailer/OEM-store URL the price observations were taken from.

fields.name: price_observations
fields.description: Recorded per-retailer price observations (retailer=price@date), the evidence behind the range.
